title.note: Game title; glossary keep (brand), Latin as the guide keeps game names.
title.blind_remark: not translated: still English, in Latin script

hud.cast.note: Masdar button per the guide: 'throwing (the line) in'. 'გადაგდება' (casting out) is 9/8, over budget; 'სროლა' would read as shooting.

hud.reel.note: Masdar 'pulling (the fish) out', 8/8; same verb as pass.auto_reel. Alternative 'ამოთრევა' (dragging out), also 8.

hud.bait_left.note: Noun after a numeral stays singular in Georgian, so one form fits 0, 1 and any count.

catch.success.note: Aorist object is nominative, so the inserted rarity and fish names stay in base form. 'შენ' marks it as a result: bare 'დაიჭირე' is also the imperative 'Catch!'.

catch.escaped.note: 'The fish got away from you...'; names the generic 'fish' because Georgian needs a subject here.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: Georgian uses a decimal comma ('12,4 კგ'); '12.4' from the game will look wrong. Format {weight} per locale if possible.

fish.golden_carp.note: 'Carp of gold', the same pattern as 'ოქროს თევზი' (goldfish); base nominative form for insertion into catch.success.

fish.lantern_eel.note: 'Lantern eel' as genitive + noun (like the guide's 'იღბლის ელექსირი'), keeping the lantern idea from the title. 16/18.

shop.equip.note: 'Select' as the button, paired with 'არჩეულია' (selected) for shop.equipped. 'აღჭურვა' (equip) is stiff, and its participle describes the player, not the rod; 'გამოყენებული' would read as 'secondhand'.

shop.equipped.note: State label 'is selected', the pair of shop.equip ('არჩევა'); a full predicate, no gender to agree.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide pattern: masdar button + adverbial '-ად' (for) after a hyphen on Robux.
shop.buy_robux.blind_remark: mixes scripts: Latin "Robux" with the Georgian case ending "-ad" hyphenated on; usual for brand names

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel with a hyphenated 'ავტო-' prefix (guide: hyphen compounds); 13/14. 'ავტომატური ამოქაჩვა' (20) is over budget. The Creator Hub store name should match.
pass.auto_reel.review_reason: Georgian spelling writes the prefixoid ავტო- fused with the next word (ავტოამწე, ავტოსადგური), so the hyphen reads as a slip; 12/14, and terms.json and the Creator Hub pass name should be updated to match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: იღბლის სატყუარა აორმაგებს იშვიათი თევზის დაჭერის შანსს!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'doubles the chance of catching rare fish'; 'your' dropped as the guide advises. Pass name built from the glossary renderings of luck and Bait.

sell.all.note: Imperative 'sell all', 12/12. The guide's masdar form 'ყველას გაყიდვა' is 14, over the 12 budget; use it if the button has room.
sell.all.blind_remark: imperative "sell!", while the other buttons use verb nouns like "Buying", "Selecting"

sell.done.note: Intransitive 'sold' avoids 'გაყიდე', which also reads as the command 'Sell!'. Singular noun and verb after a numeral fit count and coins of 1. For the developer: if {coins} arrives grouped as '1,250', Georgian reads that as a decimal; pass plain digits or a no-break space.

sell.prompt.note: 'To sell, press E' (guide's 'გასახსნელად დააჭირე E-ს' order), 21/21; E kept, dative suffix after a hyphen. Source-side: phone and console players have no E key.
sell.prompt.blind_remark: mixes scripts: Latin key letter "E" with a Georgian case ending hyphenated on; usual for key names

ascend.button.note: 'Rise (to a higher standing)', 8/10. Avoids 'ამაღლება' (also the religious Ascension) and 'ასვლა'/'აღმასვლა' (climbing); kept distinct from the guide's rebirth word 'აღორძინება'. Somewhat literary; native review should confirm kids read it as a prestige step.
ascend.button.blind_remark: bookish word meaning "rise, elevation", as in rising to power or glory

ascend.confirm.text: ახლავე გინდა აღზევება? თავიდან დაიწყებ, მაგრამ იშვიათ თევზს {bonus}%-ით უფრო ხშირად დაიჭერ.
ascend.confirm.note: Mirrors the guide's rebirth confirm; same Ascend word as ascend.button. '{bonus}%-ით' = 'by 25%'; the adjective drops '-ი' before the dative 'თევზს'.

weather.storm.text: ქარიშხალი მოდის! იშვიათი თევზი სატყუარას ეტანება.
weather.storm.note: 'biting' rendered as 'goes for the bait' (fishing sense); the same idiom is used in tip.night. Singular 'თევზი' is the generic collective.

quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay translated as 'მთვარიანი ყურე' (terms.json); the adjective drops '-ი' before '-ში'. Singular after {n} fits 1.

friends.boost.note: Statement 'fishing together with friends gives you +10% luck'; verb last, '+' kept.

trade.sent.note: 'Trade request was sent to {player}'; dative '-ს' after a hyphen is safe on any name and needs no gender.

trade.accept.note: '{player} agreed to the trade with you': intransitive verb keeps the name in nominative, avoiding ergative '-მა'.

codes.redeemed.note: Redeem = 'გააქტიურება' per the guide; 'got activated' as the result.

afk.kicked.text: ძალიან დიდხანს არაფერს აკეთებდი, ამიტომ თევზაობა შეწყდა.
afk.kicked.note: 'You did nothing for too long, so fishing stopped.' 'შეწყდა' (stopped) avoids 'შეწყვიტე', which also reads as the command 'Stop!'. No kick added.

event.ends.note: 'Until the end: {time}', 14/14; the colon keeps a suffix off {time}. If it clips, 'დარჩა: {time}' (left) is 7. For the developer: '2d 4h' in English letters; Georgian writes '2 დღე 4 სთ'.

daily.streak.text: სერია: {day} დღე ზედიზედ! დაბრუნდი ხვალ მეტი ჯილდოსთვის.
daily.streak.note: Label form 'Streak: {day} days in a row' avoids irregular ordinals ('მე-3 დღე'); singular after the numeral fits day 1. 'for more' made explicit as 'for more rewards', as the context says.

tip.night.text: რჩევა: ზოგი თევზი სატყუარას მხოლოდ ღამით ეტანება.
tip.night.note: 'Tip' = 'რჩევა' (Microsoft's label); 'bite' as 'goes for the bait', same idiom as weather.storm.

group.join.text: შემოგვიერთდი ჯგუფში და მიიღე 50 უფასო სატყუარა!
group.join.note: Guide pattern 'join us in the group'; 50 kept, singular after the numeral.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish', since the board ranks by weight; 'ყველაზე დიდი თევზი' (18/18) reads as size.
